facts.fact: The new Universal Ads Pixel consolidates tracking into one single pixel that captures up to 18 web actions across a site, including page views, add to cart, purchase, and custom events.
facts.quote: consolidates tracking into **one single pixel**that captures up to **18 web actions** across your site, including page views, add to cart, purchase, and custom events.

facts.fact: Once the new Universal Ads Pixel launches, all new campaigns using a pixel will require the updated UA Pixel as the legacy pixel is phased out.
facts.quote: Once the new pixel launches, we will begin phasing out the legacy pixel— **all new campaigns using a pixel will require the updated UA Pixel.**

facts.fact: Advertisers will have 30 days to migrate existing campaigns to the new Universal Ads Pixel.
facts.quote: You’ll have **30 days** to complete the migration to the new UA Pixel for any existing campaigns.

facts.fact: Attribution will continue to be supported for 30 days after legacy pixel deprecation.
facts.quote: Attribution will continue to be supported for **30 days** post legacy pixel deprecation.

facts.fact: Legacy pixel audiences will remain active for 180 days after deprecation.
facts.quote: Legacy pixel audiences will remain active for **180 days** post-deprecation.

facts.fact: The new Universal Ads Pixel launches in January, per the vendor's announcement.
facts.quote: Ahead of the January launch, here are a few things you need to know about the pixel upgrade to help your business.
